Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning funding for the construction of a ferry boat vessel with a capacity of at least one hundred thirty cars.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to funding for the construction of a ferry boatvessel with a capacity of at least one hundred thirty cars; adding anew section to chapter 82.32 RCW; making an appropriation; providing aneffective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The state treasurer shall deposit to the transportation 2003account (nickel account)-state appropriation on an annual basis thegreater of the following: (a) An amount equal to all sales and use taxes paid under chapters82.08 and 82.12 RCW on the fuel purchased or used by the state ferrysystem for marine purposes; or (b) Five million two hundred thousand dollars. (2) The revenue provided in this section is hereby pledged to thepayment of any bonds and the interest thereon issued under theauthority of RCW 47.10.861 for the purposes provided in section 2 ofthis act, and the legislature agrees to continue to provide these p. 1 HB 2047revenues, in amounts sufficient to pay, when due, the principal andinterest on all bonds issued under the authority of RCW 47.10.861 forthe purposes provided in section 2 of this act. (3) This section expires on the date that the bonds that are issuedfor the purposes of section 2 of this act are retired.

(1) The sum of seventyfive million dollars,or as much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for thebiennium ending June 30, 2013, from transportation 2003 account (nickelaccount)-state appropriation to the department of transportation forthe purposes of constructing a ferry boat vessel with a carryingcapacity of at least one hundred thirty cars. These funds shall beused to supplement the funds appropriated in the 20112013transportation budget for the purpose of constructing the vessel in the20112013 fiscal biennium. (2) The transportation 2003 account (nickel account)-stateappropriation in this section includes up to seventyfive milliondollars in proceeds from the sale of bonds authorized by RCW 47.10.861.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2011.
